steps.action: Prepare YPD liquid medium: dissolve 2% Peptone, 1% Yeast Extract and 0.003% Adenine in 450 mL deionized water (YP) and separately prepare 500 mL of 20% dextrose in deionized water. Cover the bottles with foil and autoclave at 120 °C for 2 h. Add 50 mL of the 20% dextrose to 450 mL YP.
steps.source_quote: After autoclaving, 50 mL of the 20% dextrose solution was added to 450 mL of the YP liquid medium to make up the yeast extract peptone dextrose (YPD) liquid medium.

steps.action: Prepare YPD agar: dissolve 2% Peptone, 1% Yeast Extract, 2% Agar and 0.003% Adenine in 450 mL deionized water, autoclave at 120 °C for 2 h, then add 50 mL of 20% dextrose. Pour into microplate Petri dishes on a clean bench (about 35-40 mL per dish) and leave on the clean bench for 2 d to harden and dry the surface. Weigh each dish for the tip-height calibration.
steps.source_quote: The petri dishes were left on a clean bench for 2 d to allow the agar to harden and the surface to dry.
steps.note: Pour volume and weighing are assumptions (Taguchi et al. 2023 preprint).

steps.action: Streak W303-1B wild-type from the -80 °C freeze stock onto a YPD agar plate and incubate 2 d at 30 °C.
steps.source_quote: The yeast strain from -80°C freeze stock was inoculated on the YPD agar medium and was incubated in a 30°C incubator (MIR-154-PJ; PHC Holdings Corporation) for 2 d.

steps.action: Add 3 mL YPD to each of two autoclaved test tubes, inoculate each with a yeast colony (one per tube) and incubate in a shaking water bath at 30 °C, 160 rpm for 16 h. These are the two biological replicates.
steps.source_quote: In two autoclaved test tubes, 3 mL of the YPD liquid medium were added to each tube, and the yeast colonies were inoculated.
steps.note: A single colony per tube is assumed.

steps.action: For each replicate, inoculate 3 mL of overnight culture into 27 mL fresh YPD in a 250 mL Erlenmeyer flask and shake at 30 °C, 160 rpm for 3 h. Transfer the 30 mL of each culture to a 50 mL tube (culture_rep1, culture_rep2).
steps.source_quote: Then, 3 mL of culture medium in the test tubes were inoculated in 27 mL of fresh YPD liquid medium in new 250 mL Erlenmeyer Flasks (Corning Inc. NY, US), and they were incubated in a shaker (BR-40LF, TAITEC CORPORATION) at 30°C and 160 rpm for 3 h.
steps.note: Culture tubes then hold 30 mL each, as loaded on deck 7.

steps.action: Load the OT-2 deck: deck 4 300 µL tips; deck 5 20 µL tips; deck 6 and deck 9 YPD agar microplate Petri dishes (lids off); deck 7 tube rack with culture rep1 (A4), culture rep2 (B4), Milli-Q water (B3); deck 8 rack with 24 empty 2 mL screw-cap tubes; deck 11 96-well plate on PlateShuttle. Set tip height for spotting from the plate weight: Z = 2 mm dish bottom + agar height + 1 mm clearance.
steps.source_quote: Deck 7, Opentrons Tube Rack with a tube holder top for 10 tubes (999-00030, Opentrons Labworks Inc.) containing three 50 mL tubes (2324-050N; IWAKI (AGC), Shizuoka, Japan)) in A4 (30 mL culture of biological replicates #1), B4 (30 mL culture of biological replicates #2), and B3 (50 mL Milli-Q water)
steps.note: Tip height calculation is from the Taguchi et al. 2023 preprint. Detailed deck design is deferred to Experimental Design.pdf.

steps.source_quote: 6) run of PlateShuttle and measurement of the absorbance at 620 nm using Absorbance 96 Plate Reader, (7) calculation of liquid volume based on absorbance at 620 nm for normalizing the cell densities between samples
steps.note: Target A620 0.020 and blank subtraction are from Taguchi et al. 2023. Dilution volumes in later steps are nominal and are replaced by the calculated values.

steps.action: Cover the two spotted dishes with lids and place them agar-side down on the flatbed scanners (Epson GT-X980) inside the 30 °C incubator, aligned to the scanner corners. Run time-lapse scanning with scan-epson-lower.sh (scanimage) at 600 dpi, colour/RGB, every 10 min for 72 h (432 images).
steps.source_quote: Time-lapse scanning was initiated using a custom script ( scan-epson-lower.sh ), which executed the Linux command ‘scanimage’ to capture images at 600 dpi resolution every 10 minutes for 72 hours, yielding a total of 432 images.
steps.note: 30 °C and colour mode are assumed (Taguchi et al. 2023 used a GT-X980 in a 30 °C incubator). Image analysis with baQFA is not part of this protocol.

assumptions: A620 target 0.020 for normalising cell density, read in a 96-well plate: taken from Taguchi et al. 2023 (bioRxiv 10.1101/2022.07.16.500326), not stated in this paper.
A620 well: 180 µL H2O + 20 µL culture (200 µL), with H2O-only blank wells H1:H3 subtracted (Taguchi et al. 2023). Mix 3 x 100 µL before reading is assumed.
The A620 reading is done in the Byonoy Absorbance 96 reader, via PlateShuttle or by hand. PlateShuttle operation is deferred to GitHub.
Dilution volumes are nominal: 20 µL culture + 280 µL water (300 µL) per 2 mL tube. In practice use the per-sample volumes calculated from A620. The paper does not state them.
The 24 x 2 mL screw-cap tubes are represented by wells A1:D6 of a deep-well plate (dilution_plate).
Pipette: the paper lists two P20 entries but also 300 µL tips, so a P300 is assumed for volumes over 20 µL. Spots use a P20 with 20 µL tips.

The test speed (50/130/210/290 µL/s, aspirate and dispense) is applied to culture to A620 wells, culture to 2 mL tubes, and 2 mL tubes to spotting wells. Water dispensing, mixing, spotting onto agar and filler transfers use the default OT-2 flow rate. Speed is given in step notes because the schema has no speed field.
Design inferred: 24 samples = 4 speeds x 2 biological replicates x 3 technical replicates, with the same 24 samples spotted on both plates (4x6 inner spots each) plus a 24-spot outer ring (6x8 grid).

Sample layout (well: speed-biorep), in spotting order: A1 50-1, A2 130-2, A3 210-1, A4 290-2, A5 50-2, A6 130-1, B1 210-2, B2 290-1, B3 290-1, B4 210-2, B5 130-1, B6 50-2, C1 290-2, C2 210-1, C3 130-2, C4 50-1, C5 130-1, C6 290-2, D1 50-1, D2 210-2, D3 130-2, D4 290-1, D5 50-2, D6 210-1. This ordering is my own interleaving; the paper's agar_plate_annotation.csv is deferred.
Agar plates are represented as 96-well plates (A1:F8 = 6x8 spot grid); inner spots B2:E7 are filled row by row from top to bottom in sample order, and the outer ring is A1:A8, F1:F8, B1:E1 and B8:E8.
The spotting wells (spot_plate A1:D6) hold 50 µL per sample; spots of 5 µL are drawn from there. Both volumes are assumed (5 µL spot from Taguchi et al. 2023).
Filler for the outer ring: 40 µL rep 1 culture + 560 µL water (nominal), spotted after the inner spots on each plate; plates are spotted sequentially, deck 6 then deck 9.
Culture resuspension before aspiration: mix 5 x 200 µL, assumed.

Agar pour volume (about 35-40 mL per dish) and weighing are assumed. Tip Z = 2 mm dish bottom + agar height + 1 mm clearance (Taguchi et al. 2023; agar density 0.00107 g/mm³, 86 mm dish diameter in that paper, to be re-measured for these dishes).
Single colony used to inoculate each overnight culture; the paper does not state colony size.
Scanner: 30 °C, colour/RGB, plates agar-side down aligned to scanner corners (Taguchi et al. 2023 used the same scanner and a 30 °C incubator; this paper scans every 10 min rather than 90 min).
Analysis (baQFA, ANOVA, RNA-seq sample preparation) is excluded; the protocol covers spotting and scanning only.
